Composite promotion-plus-effect requests are refused structurally by the kernel, not by a statement. workflow_protection is the authoritative protection classification used by both the kernel and the broker (D-019 N-1, N-4).

meta.rationale: NEW (N-1): a binding on an unprotected transition is ambiguous

bundle.description: Invalid variant: transition statements without workflow_protection (D-019 N-1: classification missing).

meta.rationale: NEW (N-1): missing classification fails closed at load

bundle.description: Invalid variant: duplicate protected edge (D-019 N-4: ambiguous definition).

meta.rationale: NEW (N-4): ambiguous definition rejected

bundle.description: Invalid variant: protected edge from a state to itself.

meta.rationale: NEW (N-4): a self edge is not a transition

bundle.description: Invalid variant: protected edge draft->verifying is bypassable through draft->planning->verifying (D-019 N-4).

meta.rationale: NEW (N-4): a protected edge reachable by an unprotected permitted route is rejected at load
